主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.55 per share of common stock for shareholders of record on January 22, 2016, with the dividend payable on February 19, 2016. The announcement was made in a press release issued on January 11, 2016. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The information in the report and the exhibit is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless specifically stated. The press release is intended to be furnished and not deemed "filed" under the Exchange Act. The filing was signed by Richard L. Bergmark, Chief Financial Officer of Core Laboratories N.V., on January 11, 2016.
